The following events took place in '''30 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*The planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] once more became the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital, this time assuming control of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] from [[Denon/Legends|Denon]].
*The Galactic Alliance officially took authority of the galaxy.
*The [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|new Jedi academy]] was constructed on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].
*[[Darth Krayt]] begins to secretly form the [[One Sith]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. {{Circa}}
*The last of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in the galaxy were exiled to [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] from the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]].
*The construction of a secret [[Corellian Home Fleet|Corellian defense fleet]] began at the [[Kiris shipyards]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]'', Chapter 1</ref>
